prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect has been seen for adoption new screens across 2 completed tests.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Trait Selector Layout: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed interactive trait selection view where users configure their pet's starting desktop behavior before completing onboarding. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support receives inquiries about how pets behave and how controls work.)
1: [finish, new_screen] First Visit Desktop Action Tips Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before finishing that demonstrates core key shortcuts and mouse interactions for desktop pets. (why: Support emails show confusion post-onboarding on how to hide, move, or speak to pets on the desktop.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Pet Personality Quiz Flow: Introduce a 3-question interactive companion matching quiz step before selecting or uploading a pet image to guide pet style selection. (why: Adoption conversion is only 66.2% with long median time (89s), and custom generation fails for several support users.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Stage Redesign: Redesign the story intro screen into an animated stage layout displaying lively desktop pet previews. (why: The initial choose_path phase drops nearly 24% of starting users within the first few seconds.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Backup Security Hint: Display a security hint on the sign-in screen explaining that account creation preserves desktop pets across restarts. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Progress Counter: Provide real-time time estimates and status hints on the waiting screen while background assets compile. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and pet rendering fails or app stalls for some desktop setups.)
6: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Split Layout: Reorganize the photo upload screen layout into a split layout showing clear sample image guidelines next to the dropzone. (why: Support tickets mention custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Path Selection Copy: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path to focus on instant pet play without technical jargon. (why: Choose path has high initial drop-off (76.2% conversion rate).)
8: [home, notification] Ready Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification opt-in switch on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while generation finishes. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading users to abandon while waiting.)
